conditions.description: Only exact native Cat, Wolf, Horse, Donkey and Mule classes with legitimate native tame owner and no unknown nonempty serialized ForgeCaps are restorable; arbitrary TamableAnimal subclasses are not admitted.

All supported types bind to either home regardless of size. Recovery requires intact loaded anchor, nearby player within32 blocks, authenticated online owner for native spawn protection and safe already-loaded full-AABB standing space.
Actual production models await user-supplied Gemini bbmodels; source geometry and static registrations do not claim completed asset/runtime acceptance.

change.summary: Add exactly two multiblock home sizes, owner-validated searchable binding GUI, one-to-one durable identity assignments and native no-loot recovery with external/above-buried-home safety search.

modifiers.before: No JEM shelter owner or companion assignment
modifiers.after: One pet per home and one home per pet; atomic reassignment, no size eligibility gate, no silent occupant eviction; unbind/removal retains dead pet native snapshot

modifiers.before: Native ordinary death and conventional loot; no JEM shelter recovery
modifiers.after: Confirmed native death snapshot/epoch journal before loot, captured drops/XP/witherrose suppressed, same UUID restored only once; snapshot retained until latest successful exact native entity IO acknowledgment

Interior first only if safe; same shared8-horizontal/32-up/8-down loaded surface search for both sizes, above dirt-covered home allowed, full collision dimensions/fluids/hazards/support/native protection checked; blocked snapshot remains durable

modifiers.before: Native cats/wolves can teleport to owner
modifiers.after: Only post-recovery native owner teleport paused until first owner rightclick; native pathfollowing/combat remains; horses/donkeys/mules gain no lock
Small PSP/L L/PPP; large LRL/L L/PPP; vanilla tags plus shared shaped serializer validates same vanilla wood family, no upstream recipe mutation
Ambiguous process crash between restoration intent and native entity write retains native snapshot and blocks automatic respawn until native reconciliation; no automatic admin repair is claimed

rationale.purpose: Implement the user's two-size, mandatory-GUI, any-size-pet shelter recovery contract without inventing pet progression, duplicating native mod resurrection or forcing chunk loads.
rationale.decision_source: User JEM_Food_PetShelters_SeasonalHUD_FINAL_v2.md plus current explicit implementation request2026-10-23; Codex chose exact native whitelist, vanilla GUI reuse, epoch/IO journal and conservative ambiguous-crash blocking.

introduced.summary: Add source shelter lifecycle and supported native recovery subset; actual shelter model integration/runtime acceptance pending.

history.summary: Source implementation of any-size binding and safe external/above-buried recovery; no QA launch or automated test claimed.

relations: Native owner identity -> one durable pet journal -> one controller binding -> safe loaded recovery -> latest native entity IO commit
notes: Five exact native entity types supported conditionally; all may bind either size. Third-party tameability is not recovery proof. Vanilla models/items/GUI texture reuse never proves actual shelter art or runtime acceptance.
